2024.title: 🇳🇿 NZ Business Tax Key Dates 2024–2025
2024.body:

March 2024

28 Mar GST return and payment due for taxable period ending 28 February GST
28 Mar AIM instalments due if you file GST monthly and have a March balance date Provisional Tax

April 2024

01 Apr New financial year begins. Final date for ratio option provisional tax applications Provisional Tax
07 Apr Terminal tax payment due (for businesses using a tax agent) Income Tax
20 Apr Employer deductions (PAYE) payment due for March — small to medium employers PAYE
20 Apr Employer deductions (PAYE) payment due for 1–15 April — large employers PAYE

May 2024

07 May GST return and payment due for taxable period ending 31 March GST

2024.title: 🇦🇺 Australian Business Tax Key Dates FY2024–2025
2024.body:
For businesses with a 30 June financial year-end. If a due date falls on a weekend or public holiday, it shifts to the next business day. Always verify with ATO.gov.au.

July 2024 — Financial Year Begins

01 Jul New financial year begins Super
14 Jul STP finalisation due — finalise Single Touch Payroll data for FY2023–2024 STP
21 Jul Monthly BAS due — lodge and pay June 2024 monthly activity statement BAS / GST
28 Jul Quarterly BAS due (Q4: Apr–Jun 2024) — self-lodgers BAS / GST
28 Jul Payroll tax annual reconciliation due in most states (QLD, NSW, VIC, ACT) Payroll Tax

August 2024

21 Aug Monthly BAS due — lodge and pay July 2024 monthly activity statement BAS / GST
25 Aug Quarterly BAS (Q4) — registered BAS/tax agent electronic lodgement extension BAS / GST
28 Aug TPAR due — Taxable Payments Annual Report for FY2023–2024 (construction, cleaning, courier, IT, security) TPAR

September 2024

21 Sep Monthly BAS due — lodge and pay August 2024 monthly activity statement BAS / GST
30 Sep STP finalisation — closely held payees (directors, family members) extended deadline STP

October 2024

21 Oct Monthly BAS due — lodge and pay September 2024 monthly activity statement BAS / GST
28 Oct Quarterly BAS due (Q1: Jul–Sep 2024) — self-lodgers BAS / GST
28 Oct PAYG instalment notice due — Q1 (Jul–Sep 2024) PAYG
31 Oct Company, individual, trust & partnership tax returns due — FY2023–2024 self-lodgers (30 Jun year-end) Income Tax
31 Oct Deadline to engage a registered tax agent for extended lodgement (to 15 May 2025) Income Tax

November 2024

21 Nov Monthly BAS due — lodge and pay October 2024 monthly activity statement BAS / GST
25 Nov Quarterly BAS (Q1) — registered BAS/tax agent electronic lodgement extension BAS / GST

December 2024

21 Dec Monthly BAS due — lodge and pay November 2024 monthly activity statement BAS / GST
Note December BAS (ATO Christmas concession): December and January BAS are both due 21 February 2025 BAS / GST

January 2025

15 Jan Large/medium trust tax returns due — trusts with income over $10M for FY2024–2025 Income Tax
Note No standard monthly BAS due — Dec and Jan BAS both due 21 February 2025 (ATO Christmas concession) BAS / GST

February 2025

21 Feb Monthly BAS due — December 2024 AND January 2025 activity statements both due this date BAS / GST
28 Feb Individual & trust tax returns — FY2024–2025 where prior year liability was $20,000+ Income Tax
28 Feb Quarterly BAS due (Q2: Oct–Dec 2024) — self-lodgers BAS / GST⚠ 28 Feb may fall on weekend — check ATO

March 2025

21 Mar Monthly BAS due — lodge and pay February 2025 monthly activity statement BAS / GST
29 Mar Quarterly BAS (Q2) — registered BAS/tax agent electronic lodgement extension BAS / GST
31 Mar End of Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) year — FBT year covers 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025 FBT

April 2025

01 Apr New FBT year begins (1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026) FBT
21 Apr Monthly BAS due — lodge and pay March 2025 monthly activity statement BAS / GST
28 Apr Quarterly BAS due (Q3: Jan–Mar 2025) — self-lodgers BAS / GST
28 Apr PAYG instalment notice due — Q3 (Jan–Mar 2025) PAYG

May 2025

15 May Individual, partnership, company & trust tax returns — FY2024–2025 via registered tax agent (standard concession) Income Tax
21 May Monthly BAS due — lodge and pay April 2025 monthly activity statement BAS / GST
21 May FBT return and payment due — for year ending 31 March 2025 (paper lodgement) FBT
26 May Quarterly BAS (Q3) — registered BAS/tax agent electronic lodgement extension BAS / GST

June 2025

05 Jun Concessional lodgement deadline — returns not required by 15 May (payment required at lodgement) Income Tax
21 Jun Monthly BAS due — lodge and pay May 2025 monthly activity statement BAS / GST
21 Jun Recommended super processing cut-off — ensure FY2025 super contributions clear by 30 June Super
25 Jun FBT return and payment — tax agent electronic lodgement extension FBT
30 Jun End of financial year. Super contributions must have cleared employee funds to be deductible Super
30 Jun Trust distribution resolutions must be signed and documented by this date Trusts
30 Jun Asset purchases for immediate tax deductions must be installed and ready for use Income Tax

Notes: Quarterly BAS self-lodger dates: 28th of month after quarter end. Agent extensions: ~4 weeks extra (no Q2 extension). Dec/Jan BAS trap: both due 21 Feb — two months of GST in one payment. Payday Super from 1 Jul 2026. Always confirm with ATO.gov.au.

2024.body:
The Canadian tax year runs 1 January to 31 December 2024. Dates apply to Canadian-controlled private corporations (CCPCs) and self-employed individuals. Always verify with Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) or your accountant.

January 2024

15 Jan Payroll remittance due — December 2023 deductions (source deductions: CPP, EI, income tax). Threshold-based frequency Payroll / CRA

March 2024

30 Apr GST/HST annual return due — for registrants with a December 31 fiscal year-end GST / HST

May 2024

October 2024

December 2024
